research_scope: Five early/base-game skills from PQ29-PQ34 selected after live repository duplicate checks. Quest placement and core classifications/costs are cross-checked where current skill-specific evidence exists; reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

records.name: Freedom Kick
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 29 — The Androids Attack; random skill reward associated with Android 17
records.skill_description: A forward-rushing Strike attack that flies around the opponent before connecting with multiple kicks.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific data identifies Freedom Kick as a 100-Ki Strike Super with four documented hits and tracking against a knocked-away target. This corrects the historical Batch 17 PQ27 attribution; the correction is already preserved separately in Batch 35. Exact reward-slot probability remains unresolved.

records.name: Energy Field
records.skill_description: Creates a protective energy barrier around the user that can be maintained with additional input.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Energy Field as a Ki Blast Evasive with a 200-stamina cost. Holding the input maintains the barrier while rapidly consuming Ki. Independent Future Warrior references confirm it is obtainable by the player in PQ29. Exact Ki drain rate and reward-slot probability remain unresolved.

records.name: Energy Barrier
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 32 — Multiple Cell Jr. Hunt; reward associated with defeating Cell
records.skill_description: Creates a barrier around the user that cancels Ki waves and can be enlarged with additional input.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Energy Barrier as a Strike Evasive with a 300-stamina cost. The barrier can be maintained with additional input using Ki and its expanded state knocks opponents back. Independent Future Warrior references confirm PQ32 acquisition; a separate source specifically reports the skill as a random Cell reward during the Ultimate Finish, so the canonical UF-only field remains unresolved rather than treating that wording as universally established reward metadata.

records.name: Death Psycho Bomb
records.skill_description: Uses a telekinetic sphere to trap an opponent at their movement path and detonate it.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data identifies Death Psycho Bomb as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super with a ranged grab/lock-on effect and explosive follow-up. Current Future Warrior references confirm it is obtainable in PQ33 and usable by the player. Exact damage and reward-slot probability remain unresolved.

records.name: Paralysis
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 34 — Return of the Ginyu Force!
records.skill_description: Freezes an opponent with psychokinesis and attacks with an ice pillar.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 skill-specific data classifies Paralysis as a 300-Ki Strike Ultimate and documents a two-hit freezing attack for approximately 25% total damage. An independent Future Warrior reference confirms PQ34 acquisition. A separate source describes the Xenoverse 2 technique as a Super Skill rather than an Ultimate, so that classification disagreement is explicitly preserved in provenance and the record remains partially verified.
